node.title: Re^5: Comparison between a string and an array
node.author: sir_jeff
node.doctext: Declaring (not assigning) $match & $res as local vars. Just a habit (I always write it this way). The long way would be : my $match; my $res; or to declare and assign : my $match=""; my $res=""; But as I said earlier - I won't use "my" if it's just rough code (as it's not a Strict script - just example code)
